entries.summary: A deliberately bounded executable subset covers root and embedded subprocess scopes, none start/end events, generic tasks, normal/conditional/default sequence flows, exclusive routing, parallel split/join epochs, Standard Loops, and FixedMultiInstance/1 on generic Tasks. Fixed multi-instance execution freezes one bounded cardinality, records stable member identity and exact counters, runs sequentially or in parallel, joins all members or terminates the remainder on the first true completionCondition, fences late completion, and causally replays failure cleanup. Collection mapping, SubProcess or CallActivity multi-instance execution, progressive behavior events, output aggregation, and open or draining groups remain unsupported.

entries.summary: FixedMultiInstance/1 executes a bounded cardinality-based generic Task profile. It evaluates loopCardinality exactly once at activation, freezes stable item:index identities, supports sequential and parallel scheduling, records exact active/completed/terminated counters, and routes once after an all join or the first true completionCondition. Remaining members are terminated before continuation; stale completeTask commands are fenced and idempotent. Boundary Error and terminal business-failure paths cancel the group before routing or failing, and the journal replays every transition exactly. XML v4 represents broader collection and behavior metadata but executable admission rejects collection sources and behavior other than All.

entries.summary: A fingerprinted protocol-v3 binding admits exact durable Task success or business-failure outcomes. A native Effect Workflow bridge checks that binding before dispatch and translates one raw managed-retry result into a portable resolution command without rerunning the handler. Only a compiled exact failure-identity mapping promotes a failure to a BPMN Error; one matching interrupting Boundary Error catches it, while unmapped or uncaught failures deterministically fail the root execution. Operational timeout, defects, and interruption remain outside Error routing. Resolution idempotency and causal journal replay are enforced. The complete Activity lifecycle and wider event catalogue remain unsupported.

entries.summary: FixedMultiInstance/1 supports WCP13 when the pinned cardinality expression is a design-time fixed model value. The kernel deliberately does not infer whether an expression is literal or activation-derived; that distinction belongs to the pinned evaluator and model profile.
